description: Search the GitDex software directory by keyword and static filters. USE WHEN the user is looking for software, or before submitting software to check for an existing record. NEEDS a short keyword query (product type, key capability), optionally platforms and pricing. Matching is plain keyword matching, not semantic: send the distinctive nouns, and try a second phrasing before concluding nothing fits. Records are in English, Chinese or both, and both versions are searched: if the user's language finds nothing, try the keywords in the other one. NO side effects; public, no sign-in. An empty result only means nothing has been submitted to GitDex yet, never that such software does not exist. Searching never implies the user wants to publish a request.

offset.description: Items to skip; use next_offset from the previous page.

platforms.description: Match software available on any of these platforms, e.g. ['ios','web','macos','windows','linux','android','cli'].

pricing.description: Match any of these pricing types.

sort.description: 'solved' puts first the software accepted by the most requesters (accepted_solution_count). That counts other people's needs, so still compare capabilities with this user's must-haves.

submitted_by.description: Only software submitted by this user: the `submitted_by.id` of a record. Lists one author's software.

name: search_software
title: Search software
